items: Yeh badalte oxidation states dikhate hain kyunke mukhtalif tadaad mein electrons kho kar mustahkam ions bana sakte hain, maslan Fe2+ aur Fe3+.
Yeh aasani se coordination compounds (complexes) banate hain, ligands ke lone pairs ko khaali d orbitals mein le kar.
Yeh rangeen ions aur complexes banate hain, kyunke roshni jazb hone par electrons kam tawanai se zyada tawanai ki satah par jate hain.
Dhaatein aur un ke compounds catalyst ka kaam karte hain, kyunke aasani se oxidation state badal lete hain.

blocks.prompt: Lohe ke do oxidation states aur un se banne wale ions batayein.

items: Badalte oxidation states, complexes, rangeen compounds, catalysis.
